name: 350 GT
description: The Lamborghini 350 GT (1964–1968) was Ferruccio Lamborghini's first production car — his answer to Enzo Ferrari after being dismissed as a tractor maker. With a 3.5-litre V12 by ex-Ferrari engineer Giotto Bizzarrini and coachwork by Touring of Milan, it immediately established that a new Italian supercar rival had arrived.
